questions.question_text: What is the role of oxygen in rusting of metals?
questions.sample_answer: Oxygen in the air reacts with metal to form oxides, which are rusty and weak, leading to corrosion.

questions.question_text: What is the difference between a combination reaction and a decomposition reaction in terms of the number of reactants and products?
questions.sample_answer: A combination reaction involves two or more reactants forming one product, whereas a decomposition reaction involves one reactant breaking down into two or more products.
